coverage: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:45 – 14:30) · Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30) · Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:45 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x bodyvests, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/video involving incidents attached following end of shift.
Alpha Route commenced. Due to rain, patrols focused on sheltered areas while maintaining presence. Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Localito Convenience Store and Daily Drip. All clear.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store, and MidCity Shopping Centre. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Remedy Coffee. No issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed. Presence maintained while monitoring for response calls.
Departed area and continued patrols due to no activity.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Location checked thoroughly. All clear.
Response call received from Localito Convenience Store regarding a male individual harassing customers and verbally yelling at members of the public.

Arrived at Localito Convenience Store. Guards spoke with the male POI and asked him to move along due to complaints; he complied but remained in the general area. Guards maintained presence for further support.
Auckland Council attended with Police dispatch. Guards moved along and left the matter with them.
Patrol continued down Queen Street with welfare checks. Welfare check completed inside Dunkin Donuts. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Checked for concerns or vagrants. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Checked in on open stores. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed. Welfare checks on open cafes and stores. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Customs Street and Albert Street. Area and bus terminal checked. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart and stores within the area. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Wyndham Street and Albert Street. No issues found.
Welfare check completed at Little Albert's Cafe, The People's Barista, Formery, and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear. Guards headed to headquarters to brief the second HOTC team.
Arrived at headquarters and remained available for response calls.
Departed headquarters and proceeded back to top of Victoria Street.
Second HOTC team dispatched and briefed. Teams split into different patrol directions.
Departed standby position at top of Victoria Street.
Arrived at headquarters for a short restroom break before continuing patrol.
Charlie Route ended. Echo Route commenced from headquarters.
Welfare check completed at Starbucks. All clear.
Welfare check completed along Upper High Street stores. All clear.
Walkthrough completed along Metropolis Hotel, Freyberg Place, and Women's Memorial Hall. No issues found.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed with no issues found. All clear.
Security presence maintained while monitoring for response calls.
Departed area and continued to next checkpoint.
Welfare checks continued along Lower High Street, Vulcan Lane, Courthouse Lane stores, and nearby businesses. All clear.
Response incident reported from Queen Street regarding a female individual passed out in front of Michael Hill. Guards arrived moments later, but POI had already gotten up and moved along.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark, Fort Street. Welfare checks with static guards and stores. Pocket Park clear. Construction build present but hidden and away from public reach.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks on stores and businesses. No reports made and no issues found.
Security presence maintained while monitoring for response calls.
Departed area and continued to next checkpoint.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Welfare checks on nearby stores. No issues.
Welfare check completed through Queens Arcade and Imperial Lane, including ground level and first level. All clear.
Heading towards headquarters to charge the Ops phone. Presence maintained up Queen Street with quick welfare checks.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone battery at 15%. Remained available for response calls while charging.
Departed headquarters with Ops phone battery at 39%.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep completed. No issues found. Presence maintained.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive check-in. Area scoped for issues. None found.
Patrolling back down Queen Street while returning to headquarters to recharge for afternoon shift. Presence maintained outside headquarters.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Afternoon shift deployed. Equipment handover completed.
Alpha Route commenced. Welfare check completed at Starbucks and Lotus. All clear. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Arrived at Chemist Warehouse check-in. Welfare check with static guard and store. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Welfare checks inside Taco Bell and Shortland Mini Mart. All clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor check completed on ground level and Level 1. No concerns. All clear. Presence maintained.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.

Welfare check inside OK Gift Shop. Staff reported a male individual who attempted theft on 20 May; the incident happened too quickly for staff to call security at the time. The POI was stopped and asked to leave without any items. (photo on file)
Response call received from 220 Queen Street requesting assistance with heavy lifting.
Arrived at 220 Queen Street. Guards assisted the Data Centre and remained available for response calls.
Departed 220 Queen Street and continued patrols.
Welfare check inside Look Sharp. Staff reported a female individual who is a regular offender and steals from the $2 store on High Street; she attempted to steal but was stopped by the manager.
Welfare check at Brand Warehouse. Manager Patricia reported an attempted theft from two weeks prior. No photo or footage available. HOTC contact number provided.
Welfare check at Coco Lane. Staff reported an individual who came in and threatened the delivery driver. Guards will continue daily checks going forward.
Welfare check inside Tatty's. Staff reported a female individual who committed theft; the previous day's afternoon team had located the POI but items were not recovered.
Second team concluded and ended their shift. Afternoon shift team commenced full route.
Arrived at corner of High Street and Shortland Street. Area scoped. No issues.
Arrived at Fort Street. Welfare checks at Right Track, Walker & Hall, Vape Haven, KFC, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Arrived at Gore Street. Welfare checks at Char Grill, King Made Noodles, PK Liquor, Smiley Mart, Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sal's Pizza, Sienna, and surrounding suites. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. Presence maintained.
Heading back to headquarters for floor checks.
Floor checks completed. First break commenced while remaining available for response calls.
Break completed. Alpha Route ended and Echo Route commenced.
Welfare check at Nike, Cotton On, Localito Convenience Store, Footlocker, Bag Planet, and Ippondo. All clear.
Welfare check at Unichem Pharmacy, Avachi, MidCity Shopping Centre, 77 Convenience Store, and McDonald's Queen Street. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Queen Street and Wellesley Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare check at Yogurt Story, Daiso Japan, and Burger Fuel. All clear.
Welfare check inside Metro Entertainment City. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep completed. No issues present. Presence maintained.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive check-in. Scoped for issues. All clear.
Walkthrough completed along Wakefield Street. All clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library. No issues to report.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. All clear.
Welfare check at Father Ted's. All clear.
Arrived at Elliott Street check-in. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott and the Food Court. All clear.
Welfare check at City Convenience Store, Mr Barber, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks on all stores. All clear. Presence maintained.
Welfare check inside Ace Karaoke. All clear. Patrol continued down Albert Street.
Response call received from Puffing Kiwi regarding an intoxicated male individual sitting outside, yelling and screaming at members of the public.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Customs Street and Albert Street. All clear.
Arrived at Puffing Kiwi. Guards spoke with the POI and moved him along due to complaints and profane verbal language directed towards members of the public.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone battery at 8%. Placed on charge while remaining available for response calls.
Lunch break commenced while preparing for changeover to night shift.
Afternoon shift completed. Equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 3x bodyvests, 2x keycards, 1x Ops phone, 4x set of keys, 1x bodycam, 1x Ops phone charger, and 2x body camera chargers.
Alpha Route commenced. Check-in completed at Chemist Warehouse and Kathmandu. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Vulcan Lane. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart. No issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay. Full sweep commenced.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store. No issues.
Check-in completed at Ace Karaoke. No issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square. Full sweep commenced.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear, no issues.
Alpha Route completed. Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Gore Street. All clear. Beta Route completed.
Check-in completed at Aotea Gifts. No issues.
Full sweep completed at St Patrick's Square. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Aotea Square. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Returning to headquarters to charge Ops phone, battery at 8%.
Check-in completed at Chemist Warehouse and Kathmandu. No issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Albert Street Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Wyndham Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Durham Street. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling upper Queen Street until handover.
Heading back to headquarters for changeover.
